lines: The sunset burns, swallowing this whole town
On a day that feels like it could swallow everything
I let you slip from my grasp
Tomorrow scares me, I hate it
So let me be swallowed too
Swallow me, sunset
But that won’t happen, will it
Tomorrow keeps coming, annoyingly relentless
In a sleepy night I somehow end up laughing
Let’s go home, let’s go alone
Let’s pretend yesterday was just a illusion
I’ll forget your face
Stupid, isn’t it? It’s stupid
The days after you left
This helpless, languid feeling
My heart and body are at odds
The unreliable me lies down
You turned into a cat, didn’t you
Someday just appear out of nowhere
Tint the ordinary days with your color
The sunset burns, swallowing this whole town
On a day that feels like it could swallow everything
I let you slip from my grasp
We’re too young; can we start over from scratch
Is it even possible to meet again
If wishing is useless, then it’s over
I hate how much I dread getting home
My walking pace stays the same as when you’re beside me
Yearning circles, tangled sighs choke me
Mock it, laugh at it
The days without you
Are boring to the point of being funny
I try with all my might to forget
My whole body still reaches for you
You turned into a cat, didn’t you
One day let me hear that voice again
Comfort this contradictory, chaotic me
The days after you left
This helpless, languid feeling
My heart and body are at odds
The unreliable me lies down
You turned into a cat, didn’t you
Someday just appear out of nowhere
Tint the ordinary days with your color
If you were a stray cat
I’d hold you tight in my arms
If you’re hurt, I’ll wipe your wounds
I’ll give you all the warmth I can
I miss you, I can’t forget
Even as a cat, I want you to appear
Someday you’ll just appear out of the blue
And I’ll be happy again
